subject: Preserve source-ordered primary-target multiplicity mutations
description: Schema-14 linux2 Profile_002 Savegame_003 replay-010 first exposed a hidden BattleDecisions target-selection divergence at frame 14540 for Soldier178 and then a missing CombatObserveSideStep RNG draw at frame 14716. Original stores muwPrimaryTargetMultiplicity as a nonserialized UWORD on each human. Its AI routines reset and increment those counters in actor-owner order; a later owner can therefore append a target whose count was reset by an earlier owner, while a newly appended target otherwise retains the live shared count. Rust instead rebuilt a broad occupancy snapshot from current swordfight states, resurrecting stale claims and selecting PC100 rather than PC101. AiGlobalState now mirrors the shared nonserialized counters with wrapping UWORD semantics, bootstraps them once from live actors, and applies the source-authorized mutations in BattleDecisions, ProposeShotTarget, ProposeGoodCombatPosition, and ReconsiderSwordfightObservation. RefreshDetection keeps its separate live-derived optical aggregate. A second hidden control in linux3 Profile_001 Continue replay-001 showed that IsTooProudToAttack reselects after BattleDecisions has performed its local resets and friend increments; Rust initially read the stale owner-start snapshot there. The strongly-unoccupied reselector now receives the live decision-local map, restoring Original's Soldier111-to-PC171 visibility query at frame 471 and all five later audit differences. Focused coverage verifies owner-ordered appended-target reset visibility, UWORD stacking, failed-shot rebuilds, and the TooProud within-call re-pick. cargo test -p robin_engine ai_enemy::battle --no-fail-fast passes 15/15, the focused TooProud regression passes 1/1, cargo fmt is clean, and the parity profile build succeeds. On the combined parity runner built 2026-08-08, linux3 Profile_001 Continue replay-001, SuN1Sh1nE Profile_004 Savegame_002 replay-009, and both task-36 controls match exact EOF. The linux2 replay-010 representative clears frames 14540 and 14716 and advances to the independent sound-manager FIFO frontier at frame 15016.
